n.quote:
A final sample of 30 (24 males, 6 females) participants with an age 23.5
± 6.3 years, VO2Max 41.88 ± 9.08 mil/min/kg, completed the study. ... The one-sided Bayes factor for the accuracy in the AX-CPT task between the first and the last 15
minutes of the task was BF01 = 4.04, indicating that the observed data support the null hypothesis of no
effect. ... The one-sided Bayes factor for the average heart rate during cycling time-to-exhaustion test was BF01
= 2.587, indicating anecdotal evidence in favor of the null hypothesis that mental fatigue did not have
a detrimental effect on the average heart rate.
